name: gr_triangle_free_exists_degree_le_half
statement: (V : Type) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] [Nonempty V] (h : G.CliqueFree 3) : ∃ v, 2 * G.degree v ≤ Fintype.card V
closed: ∀ (V : Type) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] [Nonempty V] (h : G.CliqueFree 3), ∃ v, 2 * G.degree v ≤ Fintype.card V
informal: A triangle-free graph has a vertex of degree at most n/2 — take v of minimum degree (G.exists_minimal_degree_vertex) and d = G.minDegree; Uses Mathlib2.bld2_triangle_free_min_degree_le_half at step 2 with d ≤ deg w for all w.
type: ∀ (V : Type) [inst : Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [inst_2 : DecidableRel G.Adj] [Nonempty V], G.CliqueFree 3 → ∃ v, 2 * G.degree v ≤ Fintype.card V
